goal: To monitor refrigeration units and alert managers when temperatures are outside safe ranges.
core_capabilities: Detect when temperatures drift outside predefined safe ranges.
Alert managers upon detection of unsafe temperature ranges.
main_components: Temperature Monitoring Sensors: Collect real-time temperature data from refrigeration units.
Monitoring Software: Analyzes temperature data to detect deviations from safe ranges.
Alerting Mechanism: Issues alerts to managers when unsafe temperature conditions are detected.
assumptions: Managers have appropriate means to receive alerts.
open_questions: What are the specific temperature ranges deemed unsafe for each type of refrigeration unit?
